edges: Jeremy saves Mrs. Frisby from Dragon, the farmer's cat.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mrs. Frisby obtains medicine from her friend Mr. Ages.
The rats agree to move Mrs. Frisby's house to a location safe from the plow out of respect for Jonathan.
Jeremy suggests Mrs. Frisby seek help from an owl who dwells in the forest.
Nicodemus assists Joseph in anointing Jesus' body.
Mrs. Frisby obtains medicine from her friend Mr. Ages.
Mrs. Frisby is the mother of Timothy who is ill.
Mr. Fitzgibbon begins preparation for spring plowing in the garden where Mrs. Frisby lives.
Nicodemus tells Mrs. Frisby about the rats' capture by scientists at NIMH.
Jonathan Frisby and Mr. Ages were the only two survivors of a group of mice experimented on at NIMH.
Billy captures Mrs. Frisby and puts her in a cage.
Justin comes to save Mrs. Frisby and manages to get her out of the cage.
